content: Apache AGE operational facts: pg_upgrade across major versions is NOT supported for databases containing AGE data because AGE tables use reg*-OID-referencing types that pg_upgrade can't remap, so major version upgrades require dump/restore instead; AGE currently supports Postgres 11-18 (pins below latest mainline); psycopg's connection.transaction() creates a savepoint (not a new transaction) when a transaction is already open, an easy source of half-committed AGE catalog writes; AGE DDL-like catalog writes (creating labels/graphs) are only visible to other sessions after the enclosing transaction commits, a source of apparent 'missing graph' bugs; every Cypher-returned value comes back as opaque agtype and must be explicitly cast to a plain Postgres type before use in SQL joins/comparisons.
